import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create the scatter plot

    data=df,
    x='petal_length',
    y='petal_width',
    hue='species',
    s=100,  # Set marker size
    alpha=0.8, # Set transparency
